content.title: KB Home (KBH) Stock Trades Down, Here Is Why
content.summary: Shares of homebuilder KB Home (NYSE:KBH) fell 8.8% in the morning session after the company reported fourth-quarter results that beat expectations but provided a weak outlook for 2026.

content.title: KBH Q4 Deep Dive: Margin Pressure and Build-to-Order Focus Amid Slower Home Sales
content.summary: Homebuilder KB Home (NYSE:KBH) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q4 CY2025, but sales fell by 15.3% year on year to $1.69 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.92 per share was 7.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

content.summary: ↗️ FedEx (FDX): The shipping giant posted higher revenue in its latest quarter, boosted by transporting goods at higher yields. content.title: KB Home: Fiscal Q4 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: LOS ANGELES (AP) — KB Home (KBH) on Thursday reported fiscal fourth-quarter earnings of $101.5 million. The Los Angeles-based company said it had net income of $1.55 per share. Earnings, adjusted for non-recurring costs, came to $1.92 per share.
